segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ ״שְׁבוּעָה שֶׁלֹּא אוֹכַל כִּכָּר זוֹ״; ״שְׁבוּעָה שֶׁלֹּא אוֹכְלֶנָּה״; ״שְׁבוּעָה שֶׁלֹּא אוֹכְלֶנָּה״; וַאֲכָלָהּ – אֵינוֹ חַיָּיב אֶלָּא אַחַת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If one says: On my «oath I will not eat this loaf,» and he then says again: On my «oath I will not eat it,» and again: On my «oath I will not eat it, and he» then «ate it, he is liable only once.» Once the first oath had taken effect, the subsequent oaths could not, as a prohibition cannot take effect where another prohibition is already in place.

segments.he: זוֹ הִיא שְׁבוּעַת בִּטּוּי – שֶׁחַיָּיבִין עַל זְדוֹנָהּ מַכּוֹת, וְעַל שִׁגְגָתָהּ קׇרְבָּן עוֹלֶה וְיוֹרֵד.
segments.en: «This is an oath on an utterance, for which» one is «liable» to receive «lashes for intentionally» breaking «it, and for unwittingly» breaking «it» one is liable to bring «a sliding-scale offering.»

segments.he: שְׁבוּעַת שָׁוְא – חַיָּיבִין עַל זְדוֹנָהּ מַכּוֹת, וְעַל שִׁגְגָתָהּ פָּטוּר.
segments.en: For «an oath» taken «in vain,» one is «liable» to receive «lashes when» it is taken «intentionally, and» one is «exempt when» it is taken «unwittingly.»

moves.summary: three oaths on one loaf, liable only once
penalties for an oath on an utterance

positions.claim: repeated oaths on the same loaf yield only one liability
oath on an utterance: lashes if intentional, sliding-scale offering if unwitting; vain oath: lashes if intentional, exempt if unwitting
